# Etsy MCP Skill

Use this skill whenever the task involves the Etsy API, Etsy OAuth, or changes to the user's Etsy shop (listings, inventory, orders, shipping).

Follow the instructions in [`.github/agents/etsy.agent.md`](../../agents/etsy.agent.md). That file is the single source of truth for the workflow, auth facts, write-confirmation rules and error handling. Setup steps for the user are in [`ETSY-MCP-USAGE.md`](../../../ETSY-MCP-USAGE.md).
